rationale.edition: The only changed file is web/src/components/alerts/AlertList.vue, which lives under web/src (the open-source frontend). No paths under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ are touched, and no enterprise keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/logo) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no tests-added label or skip comment in the trigger context, and the change is user-facing (it alters the Alert clone dialog), so none of the skip conditions apply.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because the change alters a user-facing UI flow: cloning a composite alert now hides the stream-type/stream-name selectors and routes through the /clone endpoint. This is new conditional behavior in the clone dialog that a user can exercise and that should be verified in the browser.
rationale.area: The change lives in web/src/components/alerts/AlertList.vue, which is the Alerts area, and the existing specs for alerts live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/, so the Alerts area is the natural home.
rationale.group: The Alerts shard group in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json has actual_folder Alerts and already runs alert specs (alerts-advanced, alerts-ui-operations, etc.), so the new spec should join that existing group rather than create a new one.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only changed file is a Vue component (web/src/components/alerts/AlertList.vue); no files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ were modified, so there are no dev-authored Playwright specs to enhance.
